_doc: Config for the 2-D feature x sample HDLSS grid sweep. 'caps' = bio_max_features buckets (null/'full' = keep every feature). 'samples' = stratified train-row caps applied train-only post-split (null = full train set). 'cv_folds' runs every cell x dataset as its own stratified k-fold CV; the fold partition seed is the CV repeat (not the cell), so all cells share one partition and the learning curve varies only the feature/sample budget on a fixed test set. 'datasets', 'datasets_regression' and 'models' are each an inline list or a path (relative to this file) to a JSON array. Run: scripts/feature_sweep.py --grid-config configs/grid_sweep.json.
